result.instructions: Tools for Shift4Shop, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders came in today, and what is their status?"; "Find the order for jane@example.com and list its items and shipments."; "Which products are on sale, and how many are in stock?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Shift4Shop data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shift4shop_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shift4shop_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shift4shop_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. shift4shop_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shift4shop_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List store orders, filterable by status, order (invoice) number, date range, last-update range or billing email. Use this first to find orders. Shift4Shop API: GET /Orders.

invoicenumberstart.description: First invoice number of a range.

invoicenumberend.description: Last invoice number of a range.

invoiceprefix.description: Only orders whose invoice number has this prefix.

orderstatus.description: Only orders in this status (see shift4shop_list_order_statuses).

datestart.description: Orders placed after this time (mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss).

dateend.description: Orders placed before this time (mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss).

lastupdatestart.description: Orders last updated after this date (mm/dd/yyyy).

lastupdateend.description: Orders last updated before this date (mm/dd/yyyy).

billingemail.description: Billing email address of the order.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

offset.description: Starting point for the returned items (0 = first).

countonly.description: Return only the number of matching rows.

tools.name: shift4shop_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by its id (the invoice number), with customer, totals and status. Shift4Shop API: GET /Orders/{orderid}.

orderid.description: The order id (invoice number), for example from shift4shop_list_orders.

tools.name: shift4shop_list_order_items
tools.title: List order items
tools.description: List the line items of one order (products, quantities, prices). Shift4Shop API: GET /Orders/{orderid}/Items.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

offset.description: Starting point for the returned items (0 = first).

tools.name: shift4shop_list_order_shipments
tools.title: List order shipments
tools.description: List the shipments recorded for one order, including tracking data. Shift4Shop API: GET /Orders/{orderid}/Shipments.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

offset.description: Starting point for the returned items (0 = first).

tools.name: shift4shop_list_order_transactions
tools.title: List order transactions
tools.description: List the payment transactions recorded for one order. Shift4Shop API: GET /Orders/{orderid}/Transactions.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

offset.description: Starting point for the returned items (0 = first).

tools.name: shift4shop_list_order_statuses
tools.title: List order statuses
tools.description: List the order statuses configured in the store (use their ids or names in shift4shop_list_orders). Shift4Shop API: GET /OrderStatus.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

offset.description: Starting point for the returned items (0 = first).

countonly.description: Return only the number of matching rows.

tools.name: shift4shop_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List store customers, filterable by email, name, country, state, city, phone or last-update range. Shift4Shop API: GET /Customers.

lastupdatestart.description: Customers last updated after this time (mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss).

lastupdateend.description: Customers last updated before this time (mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

offset.description: Starting point for the returned items (0 = first).

countonly.description: Return only the number of matching rows.

tools.name: shift4shop_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id, with contact and billing details. Shift4Shop API: GET /Customers/{id}.

id.description: The customer id, for example from shift4shop_list_customers.

tools.name: shift4shop_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List catalog products, filterable by SKU, name, cost or price range, stock range and flags (hidden, on sale, not for sale). Shift4Shop API: GET /Products.

notforsale.description: Only products set as not for sale.

lastupdatestart.description: Products last updated after this time (mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss).

lastupdateend.description: Products last updated before this time (mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

offset.description: Starting point for the returned items (0 = first).

countonly.description: Return only the number of matching rows.

tools.name: shift4shop_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product by its catalog id, with price, stock and description. Shift4Shop API: GET /Products/{catalogid}.

catalogid.description: The product catalog id, for example from shift4shop_list_products.

tools.name: shift4shop_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the store's product categories. Shift4Shop API: GET /Categories.

category.description: Find a category by its name.

offset.description: Starting point for the returned items (0 = first).

countonly.description: Return only the number of matching rows.

tools.name: shift4shop_get_category
tools.title: Get a category
tools.description: Get one product category by id. Shift4Shop API: GET /Categories/{categoryid}.

categoryid.description: The category id, for example from shift4shop_list_categories.

tools.name: shift4shop_get_store_settings
tools.title: Get store settings
tools.description: Get the store's general settings (store name, currency and other configuration). Shift4Shop API: GET /StoreSettings.
